title: cc-oc user config
description: User config for the cc-oc Claude Code plugin. Lives at ~/.claude/oc.json. Every field is optional — built-in defaults work without this file.
markdownDescription:
User config for the **cc-oc** Claude Code plugin — a controlled launcher for `opencode run` invoked from Claude Code.

Lives at `~/.claude/oc.json`. Every field is optional — the plugin works with no config file at all. Add `"$schema": "https://github.com/anfreire/cc-oc/raw/main/plugins/oc/schemas/oc.config.schema.json"` to get rich tooltips in your editor.

$schema.description: Schema URL. Point this at the cc-oc schema for editor tooltips and validation.

opencode.description: Defaults for every /oc:spawn (overridable per-call via flags).
opencode.markdownDescription:
Defaults for every `/oc:spawn`. Any per-call flag (`--provider`+`--model` paired, `--agent`, `--write`, `--exclude-mcp`, etc.) overrides the corresponding value here for that single spawn.

These settings only control **how cc-oc invokes opencode**. They never modify your opencode config files at `~/.config/opencode/` or `<cwd>/.opencode/` — opencode reads those itself.

model.description: Default model in provider/model form. null = inherit OpenCode's configured default.
model.markdownDescription:
Default model for every `/oc:spawn` call.

Use **`provider/model`** form (e.g. `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6`, `opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash`). The plugin passes the string through verbatim — opencode validates the id and errors if it doesn't recognize it.

`null` = inherit opencode's own configured default.

variant.description: Default model variant. Passed through verbatim. null = inherit OpenCode's default for the chosen model.
variant.markdownDescription:
Default model variant for every `/oc:spawn` call.

Some providers expose model variants (e.g. reasoning-effort tiers on `opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash`). The plugin passes this string through to `opencode run --variant <name>` verbatim.

opencode silently ignores variants on providers that don't support them.

`null` = inherit opencode's default variant for the chosen model.

agent.description: Default OpenCode agent name to pin every spawn to. null = OpenCode picks.
agent.markdownDescription:
Default opencode agent name to pin every `/oc:spawn` to (e.g. `build`, `plan`).

`null` = let opencode pick its own default.

sandbox.description: Default sandbox mode. Override per-call with --read-only / --write.
sandbox.markdownDescription:
Default sandbox mode for `/oc:spawn`.

- **`read-only`** (default) — cc-oc does **not** pass `--dangerously-skip-permissions`. The spawn runs under opencode's own permission model (`permission.edit`, `permission.bash`, …). With opencode's stock defaults that's effectively read-only because non-interactive runs can't satisfy `"ask"` prompts, but if your opencode config sets `permission.edit: "allow"` that setting wins. This is opencode-side gating, not a plugin enforcement.
- **`workspace-write`** — cc-oc passes `--dangerously-skip-permissions`, bypassing every opencode permission prompt for the spawn.

Override per-call with `--read-only` / `--write`.

excludeMcps.description: MCP server names (from your opencode config) to disable for every spawn. Per-call --exclude-mcp adds, --include-mcp removes.
excludeMcps.markdownDescription:
MCP server names — as configured in your **opencode** config (`~/.config/opencode/opencode.json::mcp.*` keys) — to **disable** for every `/oc:spawn`.

cc-oc writes a per-spawn override of `mcp.<name>.enabled = false` on top of your opencode config, so listed servers won't be loaded for the spawned task. Other servers remain unaffected.

Per-call adjustments:
- `--exclude-mcp foo,bar` adds to the effective exclude list.
- `--include-mcp foo` removes names from the effective list, which re-enables a server you've configured to skip globally for one specific run.

disableProjectConfig.description: Set OPENCODE_DISABLE_PROJECT_CONFIG=1 for every spawn. Skips the workspace's .opencode/.
disableProjectConfig.markdownDescription:
Set `OPENCODE_DISABLE_PROJECT_CONFIG=1` for every spawn.

When `true`, opencode ignores the workspace-level `.opencode/` configuration. Useful when you want every spawn to use only your global opencode config without per-project surprises.

Override per-call with `--no-project`.

pure.description: Pass --pure to opencode (skip external OpenCode plugins).
pure.markdownDescription:
Pass `--pure` to `opencode run` for every spawn.

When `true`, opencode skips its **external** plugins (npm-installed `opencode-*` packages and file-loaded `.opencode/plugins/*.{ts,js}`).

Override per-call with `--pure` / `--no-pure`.

retention.description: How aggressively to prune old session logs on CC SessionEnd.
retention.markdownDescription:
How aggressively to prune old session logs on CC SessionEnd.

The `gc` hook runs at the end of every Claude Code session. It marks still-running sessions as `detached` (preserves them in the index) and prunes logs by age, then by total size.

logsDays.description: Delete log files older than this many days. Default: 14.

maxLogsMb.description: After age-based prune, drop oldest logs until total size is under this cap. Default: 500.
